recreation_brief: 1. White background slide. 2. Top center: bold red (~#CC0000) title 'Example:  Distance with Normalization', underline the word 'with'. 3. Top-right: yellow circle (#FFFF99) with thin dark outline containing '54'. 4. Draw a thin red rectangular border enclosing the content area below the title. 5. Inside, top-left: bold black text 'Feature Vector  for bars:'. 6. Create a grid: left row labels 'Weight (KG)' and 'Length (cm)' bold black; column headers 'Red Class' (red), 'Blue Class' (blue), 'Green Class' (green), 'Mean' and 'S.D' (black). 7. Under each class header place parenthesized column vectors in the class color: Red (2,3,4)/(100,150,200); Blue (7,8,9)/(150,200,250); Green (12,13,14)/(150,250,300); Mean (8)/(194.44); S.D (4.163)/(59.835). Add a small '+' above the red '3'. 8. Below, add headers 'Normalized Red Class' (red), 'Normalized Blue Class' (blue), 'Normalized Green Class' (green), 'Normalized Test' (black). 9. Fill normalized vectors: Red weight (-1.441,-1.201,-0.961), length (-1.578,-0.743,0.093); Blue weight (-0.24,0,0.24), length (-0.743,0.093,0.928); Green weight (0.961,1.201,1.441), length (-0.743,0.928,1.764); Test column vector (-0.24,-1.244) in black. 10. Add bold black line 'Squared distance between each Normalized vector and Normalized test vector'. 11. Below it place three parenthesized groups: red '(1.554   1.175   2.307)', blue '(0.251   1.845   4.948)', green '(1.693   6.794   11.874)'; draw a yellow ellipse around '0.251'. 12. Bottom-left: beige box (#F5E8C8) with thin border containing 'Normalized X = (X - Mean)/(S.D.)' as a fraction. 13. Bottom-right: beige box containing the column vector (7 over 100) in parentheses, then 'Belongs to   Blue Class' with 'Blue Class' bold blue.
